realm.name: default-roles-mesail

clients.name: Mesail identity service
clients.description: The only client that signs people in: the identity service, server to server, with the password grant. Keycloak asks for a TOTP code when the person has one. Its tokens never leave the identity service (ADR 0005).

clients.name: Mesail account settings
clients.description: The identity service changes a person's own password, TOTP and sessions through the admin API of this realm. Its service account may only view and manage users.

clients.name: Mesail directory
clients.description: The directory service creates, disables and deletes people and resets their credentials through the admin API of this realm. Its service account may only view, query and manage users.
